info.title: bmo-cache-warmer
info.description: A keepalive scheduler for prompt caches: consumers register targets (cached prefixes), record each use, and are asked to ping a target before its cache runs out. Asking is the target-ping webhook each consumer serves at the URL it registered; the service names no consumer and calls no other service. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys; times are integers of epoch milliseconds. A list is a page in id order, `after` being the id of the last item read. Every failure is answered in the error shape with its status. The harness plugin's tools, each a thin call of one route, are stated under `x-tools`.

x-harness.entry: A harness registers its long prefix as a target with warmer_target_put and marks it used after each request with warmer_target_used, so the warmer pings it before the cache runs out.

Error.description:
A failure, in the common error shape. The codes:
- `bad-request` (400): the body, the query or a name in the path is not the shape the route takes
- `unauthorized` (401): the bearer token is missing or wrong
- `no-route` (404): no route answers this method and path
- `not-found` (404): nothing stands at the names the path gives
- `conflict` (409): a target still names the group
- `gone` (410): the events past the cursor asked for are no longer kept
- `invalid-url` (422): the hook URL does not parse or is not http
- `invalid-clock` (422): a span or a time is out of its range
- `invalid-kind` (422): the kind is not a kind word
- `unknown-group` (422): the registration names no group of the consumer
- `failed` (500): the store could not be read or written
